name: Hammer
idea: Drive along the baseline, and when the defense helps, throw it all the way across to the open corner.
why: When the driver gets close to the hoop, a defender has to help. A teammate’s screen keeps the shooter’s defender from getting back to the corner. It’s a famous play in the NBA.
tryit: Shooter: slide to the corner when the drive starts, with your hands ready. Driver: jump stop under control, then look across the baseline.

frames.say: {1} has the ball on the right wing. {2}, our shooter, waits on the other side.
*Hammer:* {X5} steps over to help. On the other side, {4} screens {X2}, and {2} slides down to the corner.
{1} throws it all the way across to {2} in the corner.
Corner three! Drive, help, hammer, swish.
